title.en: On the board: Business, profession, employment

narration.en: Let us compare the three economic activities on the board, basis by basis.

say.en: Let us compare the three economic activities on the board, basis by basis.
Business starts with your own decision; a profession needs membership of a body; employment needs an appointment letter.
Profit is uncertain, a fee is fairly regular, and salary is fixed. So risk falls from high to nil.
Only a business interest can be transferred; professionals follow a code, employees follow service rules.
Test it: a doctor in practice is a profession, but the owner of a hospital runs a business.

explanation.en: Business earns uncertain profit and needs capital; a profession gives expert service for a fee and needs membership of a professional body; employment means working for others for a salary under a contract of service.

text.en: Owner of a bakery in Mangaluru
A trader who buys mangoes in bulk to sell in cities
A founder who makes and sells e-bikes
A chartered accountant auditing a company's books for a fee
A lawyer arguing a client's case
An architect designing houses for clients
A nurse working at a hospital for a salary
A software engineer on the payroll of an IT company

body.en: Business starts with the entrepreneur's decision, needs capital according to its size, earns uncertain profit and its interest can be transferred. A profession starts with membership of a professional body, needs limited capital, earns a fairly regular fee and must follow a professional code of conduct. Employment starts with an appointment letter, needs no capital, earns a fixed salary and carries almost no risk.

points.en: Capital: as per size / limited / none
Transfer of interest: possible / not possible / not possible
Code of conduct: none / professional code / employer's rules

narration.kn: ವ್ಯವಹಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಮತ್ತು ಅಪಾಯ ಹೆಚ್ಚು, ಹಿತಾಸಕ್ತಿ ವರ್ಗಾವಣೆ ಸಾಧ್ಯ. ವೃತ್ತಿಗೆ ವೃತ್ತಿಪರ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಸದಸ್ಯತ್ವ ಮತ್ತು ನೀತಿಸಂಹಿತೆ ಬೇಕು. ಉದ್ಯೋಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಬೇಕಿಲ್ಲ, ಅಪಾಯ ಕಡಿಮೆ.

problem.en: Identify the activity: (a) Asha, an advocate, runs her own law office. (b) Kiran runs a mobile accessories shop. (c) Farhan, a chartered accountant, works as finance officer in a cement company.

steps.en: (a) Personal expert service, member of the Bar Council, earns fees: profession.
(b) Buys and sells goods regularly for profit: business.
(c) Works for an employer for a salary: employment, even though he is a qualified professional.
